title.text: A small town. A job that's fine. A life that's fine. You.
Your days wait for you. The town keeps living. Nothing here is graded.

help.crisis: If you're in crisis or thinking about suicide, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, US). Free, any time.
SAMHSA National Helpline: 1-800-662-4357. Free, confidential, 24/7 treatment referral and information.
Outside the US, findahelpline.com lists free support near you.
If you're in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
help.notTreatment: This game is not treatment. It isn't medical, mental health or professional advice, and it doesn't replace needed care or emergency services.
help.how: Move through town on the map. Places open and close by the clock, and travel takes time.

Some moments become encounters with the old voice. Resolve is yours, Pull is its. Escape cards are always in hand. Every encounter ends one of four ways: acted, adjusted, delayed or escaped. None of them is a loss. Night falls either way.
The record writes down what happened, with times. It never scores you.
Days end at night. That's the stopping point. Your day waits for you.
help.reminderText: Optional. Off by default. The game will tell you once when the time has passed. It never shows a countdown.
help.frames: The game is built on Jim Lunsford's frameworks: The PERIOD Code, How to Rebuild Yourself, The Discipline Loop and Pure Execution Mode. They're named openly where they show up. Only Empowerment teaches them.
help.saveText: The game saves on this device as you play. Nothing is sent anywhere.
